notes: New in v2.103: all Hi-Tech gateway processors are wired end to end (Authorize.Net, USAePay, Elavon Converge, First Data e4, eProcessing Network, RedFin, Magnoria) so organizations can pick any of them as live processing; card checkout, recurring charges, and pledge charging work through gateways; OrangePay setup guidance added to its supported connections; sign-ups now show which processors support donor-advised funds (DAF).
